args.title: Fix "Malformed row" error message to match Windows accounting tool output
args.body:
File: src/i18n/en.json

The error message "Malformed row: the number of columns does not match the header" is too generic and does not help users diagnose issues when uploading files from Windows accounting tools. Update the message to clarify that the problem may arise from column mismatches caused by the new tool's export format, and suggest verifying the CSV structure matches the expected columns (date, amount, description).
